caption: A rich, creamy tonkotsu ramen broth glistens in a black bowl, topped with tender chashu pork, shredded cabbage, and fresh greens. Warm lighting highlights the dish against a wooden table, with a glass and bottle softly blurred in the background.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and a glossy surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its surface.
Black ceramic bowl with glossy finish, featuring two white brushstroke lines and subtle speckled texture on its curved rim.
